gpt-6-luna.verified: Course-provided figures. Not cross-checked against a provider price page or a Portkey invoice.
gpt-6-luna.cached_input_note: No cached-input rate is published in the source, so cached tokens are billed at the full input rate. Reported costs are therefore an upper bound, and caching shows no cost saving here even when it saves real money.

measured.note: Sums of token counts returned by the API for each request (data/requests.jsonl).
measured.summary_basis: Averages use 40 fresh simulations (every request a confirmed new model call). 11 other simulations are listed but excluded because some requests were gateway cache hits or were logged before cache status was recorded.

quality_rubric.in_character: No reply broke character, and the output guard never had to regenerate.
quality_rubric.facts_consistent: Every number the character said appears in the scenario data or the user's own words.
quality_rubric.concise: Every character reply is 90 words or fewer.
quality_rubric.varied: No two character replies are more than 60% similar (difflib ratio).
quality_rubric.feedback_grounded: Feedback has all parts, validated on the first try, with no fabricated quotes removed.

assumptions: Each user completes 8 full practice sessions (conversation + feedback) per month.
Cost per session = the measured mean across 40 real runs ($0.00213); the high estimate uses the measured p90 ($0.00245).
Decode This Situation is generated once per scenario and cached for everyone, so its measured cost ($0.00197 across 7 requests) is added once, not per user.
Prices from pricing.json. Cached input tokens are billed at the full input rate (cached rate unpublished), so real costs may be lower.
Excludes hosting, storage, and any free-tier or volume discounts.
